description: Collective Adaptive Systems -- adversarial dual. Can the attacker (now the coalition) compromise the WHOLE collective, breaching every member against the defending managers (now the adversary)? Expected UNKNOWN/FALSE: each round the collective notifies and adapts a member before the breach lands, so at least one member always becomes invulnerable and the attacker cannot reach compromised >= N. Soundness dual of the resilience invariant <cas>G{compromised < N}; matches that even the weakest topology is not always 100% compromised.
